question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Blend
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 3**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"Blend"** means to mix different substances or things together. (मिश्रण करना) • **Example:** She decided to blend the different spices to create a unique flavor. • **"Mix" **refers to combining or putting together to form one substance or mass. (मिश्रण करना) • **Example:** To make the cake, you need to mix flour, sugar, and eggs together. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Disperse **(बिखेरना): To distribute or spread over a wide area. • **Example:** The police used tear gas to disperse the crowd. • **Boil **(उबालना): To heat a liquid until it bubbles and turns to vapor. • **Example:** Please boil the water before drinking it. • **Divide** (विभाजित करना): To separate into parts or groups. • **Example:** The teacher decided to divide the class into small groups for the activity. 1bf:T993b,
